name: cmb-cosmological-parameter-inference-workflow
description: Use when observed CMB likelihood data and Lambda-CDM priors must be assembled into a callable CAMB likelihood, sampled for cosmological parameters, cleared of burn-in, diagnosed for autocorrelation, and summarized as physical constraints.

name: transit-lightcurve-mcmc-comparison-workflow
description: Use when one or more photometric transit light curves must be detrended, fitted jointly with a transit-and-noise MCMC model, and compared with an external table of published transit parameters.
